notes: Gives 16 as the minimum age but omits that Member States may lower it by up to 4 years in the open category (valid only in their territory), which my reference includes.
Gives the 150 m distance but omits the condition that no uninvolved person is expected to be endangered, which my reference includes (graded strictly, consistent with q02).

Describes the C1 technical features (mass, speed, height limit, remote ID, geo-awareness, etc.) but never mentions the green flashing light, which my reference lists as a C1 feature (graded strictly, consistent with q02 and q04).

Says registration runs through a system established by the competent national aviation authority; Article 14 says Member States establish the systems and the retrieved passages do not name the authority.

Still says a modified C1 may be operated 'unless it qualifies as a privately built UAS under subcategory A3'; the AMC says it may only be operated in the specific category (the privately built exception is for C4 only). Misleading and not in the passages.
Correct refusal, but names Regulations (EU) 2021/664, 2021/665 and 2021/666 as the U-space rules; those numbers are not in any retrieved passage.

Correct refusal, but says insurance is 'only mentioned ... if required by national law' (Article 14(2)(d) says 'Union or national law') and that minimums depend on national law; neither is in the retrieved passages.
